    Hubs = {h1, h2}
    Slots = {s1, s2}
    MaxTerm = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT SlotBooksBalance
PROPERTY HeldSlotEventuallyReturned
nl:
A smart-home door lock network allocates radio time slots to its devices, the
hallway lock and the garage lock. One hub at a time is the elected leader and only
the installed leader hands out slots; leadership carries a term number that
advances with each election until the term counter reaches its ceiling, after
which elections install a new leader under the standing term. The installed leader
can fail at any moment, leaving the network with no leader until the next
election.

The network tracks which slots are in service, which in-service slots are free,
and which slots each of the two devices is holding. Slots go in and out of service
at runtime as radio channels are opened and closed for interference.

The installed leader can grant a free slot to a device, which takes the slot out
of the free set and adds it to that device's holdings. A device can return a slot
it holds, which puts it back into the free set. Taking a slot out of service is
maintenance work and does not go through the leader: it removes the slot from the
in-service set, from the free set, and from whichever device's holdings it was in,
all in one step. Putting a slot into service adds it to the in-service set and to
the free set.

The complete set of actions is: elect a hub as leader, fail the installed leader,
grant a free slot to a device, return a held slot to the free set, take a slot out
of service while revoking it wherever it sits, and put a slot into service.

SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of free slots plus the number of slots the hallway
lock holds plus the number of slots the garage lock holds is always exactly the
number of slots in service, an accounting identity that would break the moment one
slot were counted in two places at once.

LIVENESS PROPERTY: every slot a device is holding is eventually not held by that
device.

EXTENDS Integers

CONSTANTS RingSize, Entries, MaxSerial

Desks == 1..RingSize
Admin == 0
Nobody == -1

VARIABLES tokenAt, serial, postedBy, postedSerial, seized

vars == <<tokenAt, serial, postedBy, postedSerial, seized>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ tokenAt \in Desks
    /\ serial \in 0..MaxSerial
    /\ postedBy \in [Entries -> Desks \union {Admin, Nobody}]
    /\ postedSerial \in [Entries -> 0..MaxSerial]
    /\ seized \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
    /\ tokenAt = 1
    /\ serial = 0
    /\ postedBy = [e \in Entries |-> Nobody]
    /\ postedSerial = [e \in Entries |-> 0]
    /\ seized = FALSE

PassToken ==
    /\ ~seized
    /\ serial < MaxSerial
    /\ tokenAt' = (tokenAt % RingSize) + 1
    /\ serial' = serial + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<postedBy, postedSerial, seized>>

PostEntry(e) ==
    /\ ~seized
    /\ postedBy[e] = Nobody
    /\ postedBy' = [postedBy EXCEPT ![e] = tokenAt]
    /\ postedSerial' = [postedSerial EXCEPT ![e] = serial]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenAt, serial, seized>>

VoidEntry(e) ==
    /\ postedBy[e] # Nobody
    /\ postedBy' = [postedBy EXCEPT ![e] = Nobody]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenAt, serial, postedSerial, seized>>

SeizeRing ==
    /\ ~seized
    /\ serial < MaxSerial
    /\ seized' = TRUE
    /\ serial' = serial + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenAt, postedBy, postedSerial>>

ReleaseRing ==
    /\ seized
    /\ serial < MaxSerial
    /\ seized' = FALSE
    /\ serial' = serial + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenAt, postedBy, postedSerial>>

AdminPostEntry(e) ==
    /\ seized
    /\ postedBy[e] = Nobody
    /\ postedBy' = [postedBy EXCEPT ![e] = Admin]
    /\ postedSerial' = [postedSerial EXCEPT ![e] = serial]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenAt, serial, seized>>

Next ==
    \/ PassToken
    \/ \E e \in Entries : PostEntry(e)
    \/ \E e \in Entries : VoidEntry(e)
    \/ SeizeRing
    \/ ReleaseRing
    \/ \E e \in Entries : AdminPostEntry(e)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CurrentSerialPostingsAreAuthorised ==
    \A e \in Entries :
        (postedBy[e] # Nobody /\ postedSerial[e] = serial)
            => postedBy[e] \in {tokenAt, Admin}

CONSTANTS
    RingSize = 3
    Entries = {e1, e2}
    MaxSerial = 3
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT CurrentSerialPostingsAreAuthorised
nl:
A bank's interbank settlement batch lets its desks post entries into the batch
journal one at a time. The desks sit in a fixed ring and a single token
circulates; the desk holding the token is the one entitled to post. The ring also
carries a serial number, and every movement of posting authority bumps that
serial, so a serial value identifies exactly one period of authority.

The token can be passed on to the next desk in the ring, which bumps the serial.
The desk holding the token can post an entry that has not been posted yet,
stamping the entry with itself as the poster and with the serial in force at that
moment. Any posted entry can be voided, which clears its poster and makes it
available to be posted again.

The settlement administrator holds a privileged override. The administrator can
seize the ring, which stops the desks posting altogether and bumps the serial, and
can release the ring again, which also bumps the serial. While the ring is seized
the administrator can post an entry directly, stamping the entry with the
administrator as poster and with the current serial. Passing, seizing and
releasing are all unavailable once the serial counter has been used up.

The complete set of actions is: pass the token to the next desk in the ring, post
an entry as the token holder, void a posted entry, seize the ring as
administrator, release the ring, and post an entry directly as administrator.

SAFETY PROPERTY: every posted entry stamped with the ring's current serial was
posted either by the desk that holds the token right now or by the administrator,
so no desk left stale by a token pass or by an administrator seizure has an entry
standing under the current authority.

---- MODULE W4Od5m2p3t0 ----
EXTENDS Integers

CONSTANTS Services, Matches, Slots

Idle == "idle"
Preparing == "preparing"
Committed == "committed"
Aborted == "aborted"
NoSlot == "noslot"
NoMatch == "nomatch"

VARIABLES phase, votes, slotOf, reservedFor, crashed

vars == <<phase, votes, slotOf, reservedFor, crashed>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ phase \in [Matches -> {Idle, Preparing, Committed, Aborted}]
    /\ votes \in [Matches -> SUBSET Services]
    /\ slotOf \in [Matches -> Slots \union {NoSlot}]
    /\ reservedFor \in [Slots -> Matches \union {NoMatch}]
    /\ crashed \subseteq Services

Init ==
    /\ phase = [m \in Matches |-> Idle]
    /\ votes = [m \in Matches |-> {}]
    /\ slotOf = [m \in Matches |-> NoSlot]
    /\ reservedFor = [s \in Slots |-> NoMatch]
    /\ crashed = {}

BeginMatch(m, s) ==
    /\ phase[m] = Idle
    /\ slotOf[m] = NoSlot
    /\ reservedFor[s] = NoMatch
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![m] = Preparing]
    /\ slotOf' = [slotOf EXCEPT ![m] = s]
    /\ reservedFor' = [reservedFor EXCEPT ![s] = m]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![m] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED crashed

VoteYes(sv, m) ==
    /\ phase[m] = Preparing
    /\ sv \notin crashed
    /\ sv \notin votes[m]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![m] = votes[m] \union {sv}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, slotOf, reservedFor, crashed>>

CommitMatch(m) ==
    /\ phase[m] = Preparing
    /\ votes[m] = Services
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![m] = Committed]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, slotOf, reservedFor, crashed>>

AbortMatch(m) ==
    /\ phase[m] = Preparing
    /\ crashed # {}
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![m] = Aborted]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![m] = {}]
    /\ reservedFor' = [reservedFor EXCEPT ![slotOf[m]] = NoMatch]
    /\ slotOf' = [slotOf EXCEPT ![m] = NoSlot]
    /\ UNCHANGED crashed

ResetMatch(m) ==
    /\ phase[m] = Aborted
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![m] = Idle]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, slotOf, reservedFor, crashed>>

ReleaseCommitted(m) ==
    /\ phase[m] = Committed
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![m] = Idle]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![m] = {}]
    /\ reservedFor' = [reservedFor EXCEPT ![slotOf[m]] = NoMatch]
    /\ slotOf' = [slotOf EXCEPT ![m] = NoSlot]
    /\ UNCHANGED crashed

CrashSilently(sv) ==
    /\ sv \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \union {sv}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, votes, slotOf, reservedFor>>

RestartService(sv) ==
    /\ sv \in crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \ {sv}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, votes, slotOf, reservedFor>>

Next ==
    \/ \E m \in Matches, s \in Slots : BeginMatch(m, s)
    \/ \E sv \in Services, m \in Matches : VoteYes(sv, m)
    \/ \E m \in Matches : CommitMatch(m)
    \/ \E m \in Matches : AbortMatch(m)
    \/ \E m \in Matches : ResetMatch(m)
    \/ \E m \in Matches : ReleaseCommitted(m)
    \/ \E sv \in Services : CrashSilently(sv)
    \/ \E sv \in Services : RestartService(sv)

Spec ==
    /\ Init
    /\ [][Next]_vars
    /\ \A m \in Matches : SF_vars(ReleaseCommitted(m))

MatchSlotIsReservedForIt ==
    \A m \in Matches : slotOf[m] # NoSlot => reservedFor[slotOf[m]] = m

CommittedMatchEventuallyReleases ==
    \A m \in Matches : (phase[m] = Committed) ~> (phase[m] # Committed)

====
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker allocates lobby slots to matches using a
two-phase commit across its services: the lobby server and the anti-cheat service
must both agree before a match takes a slot. Each slot records the match it is
reserved for, or that it is unreserved, and each match records the slot it is
going for, or that it has none.

An idle match with no slot of its own can begin on an unreserved slot: the match
moves into the preparing phase, the slot is reserved for that match, the match
records the slot, and the vote set starts empty. A service that has not crashed
and has not already voted for a preparing match can vote yes. A preparing match
whose votes cover every service moves to committed.

A preparing match can be aborted whenever some service has crashed. Aborting
clears the votes and gives the slot back on both sides at once: the slot's
reservation is cleared and the match's own record of the slot is cleared. An
aborted match can be reset to idle. A committed match releases its slot the same
way, clearing the reservation and its own record together, and returns to idle.

A service can crash silently, changing nothing else, and a crashed service can be
restarted.

The complete set of actions is: begin an idle match on an unreserved slot, vote
yes for a preparing match, commit a preparing match whose votes cover every
service, abort a preparing match while some service is crashed, reset an aborted
match to idle, release a committed match's slot and return it to idle, crash a
service silently, and restart a crashed service.

SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever a match records a slot as the one it is going for, that
slot is reserved for exactly that match, so no lobby slot is ever recorded against
two matches at once.

LIVENESS PROPERTY: every match that reaches the committed phase eventually leaves
it.

---- MODULE W4Od7m9p3t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers

CONSTANTS Vessels, Stacks, MaxEpoch

FreeStack == "free"

VARIABLES epoch, usable, allocation, heldBy, seized

vars == <<epoch, usable, allocation, heldBy, seized>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ usable \subseteq Stacks
    /\ allocation \in [Stacks -> Vessels \union {FreeStack}]
    /\ heldBy \in [Vessels -> SUBSET Stacks]
    /\ seized \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ usable = Stacks
    /\ allocation = [st \in Stacks |-> FreeStack]
    /\ heldBy = [v \in Vessels |-> {}]
    /\ seized = FALSE

Reconfigure(us) ==
    /\ ~seized
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ us # usable
    /\ \A st \in Stacks : st \notin us => allocation[st] = FreeStack
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ usable' = us
    /\ UNCHANGED <<allocation, heldBy, seized>>

AllocateStack(v, st) ==
    /\ st \in usable
    /\ allocation[st] = FreeStack
    /\ allocation' = [allocation EXCEPT ![st] = v]
    /\ heldBy' = [heldBy EXCEPT ![v] = heldBy[v] \union {st}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, usable, seized>>

ReleaseStack(v, st) ==
    /\ st \in heldBy[v]
    /\ allocation' = [allocation EXCEPT ![st] = FreeStack]
    /\ heldBy' = [heldBy EXCEPT ![v] = heldBy[v] \ {st}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, usable, seized>>

SeizeYard ==
    /\ ~seized
    /\ seized' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, usable, allocation, heldBy>>

ReleaseYard ==
    /\ seized
    /\ seized' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, usable, allocation, heldBy>>

ForceUsableSet(us) ==
    /\ seized
    /\ us # usable
    /\ usable' = us
    /\ allocation' = [st \in Stacks |->
                        IF st \in us THEN allocation[st] ELSE FreeStack]
    /\ heldBy' = [v \in Vessels |-> heldBy[v] \cap us]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, seized>>

ReassignStack(st, v) ==
    /\ seized
    /\ st \in usable
    /\ allocation[st] # v
    /\ allocation' = [allocation EXCEPT ![st] = v]
    /\ heldBy' = [w \in Vessels |->
                    IF w = v THEN heldBy[w] \union {st} ELSE heldBy[w] \ {st}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, usable, seized>>

Next ==
    \/ \E us \in SUBSET Stacks : Reconfigure(us)
    \/ \E v \in Vessels, st \in Stacks : AllocateStack(v, st)
    \/ \E v \in Vessels, st \in Stacks : ReleaseStack(v, st)
    \/ SeizeYard
    \/ ReleaseYard
    \/ \E us \in SUBSET Stacks : ForceUsableSet(us)
    \/ \E st \in Stacks, v \in Vessels : ReassignStack(st, v)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

HeldStacksAreAllocatedToHolder ==
    \A v \in Vessels : \A st \in heldBy[v] : allocation[st] = v

====
nl:
A container-ship crane yard allocates yard stacks to vessels. Which stacks are
usable is decided by epoch-numbered reconfiguration: the yard holds an epoch
number and the set of usable stacks. Each stack records the vessel it is allocated
to, or that it is free, and each vessel separately records the set of stacks it is
holding.

A normal reconfiguration advances the epoch and installs a new usable set, but it
is only available when every stack being dropped from the usable set is already
free, and it is blocked while the yard superintendent has seized the yard. A
vessel can be allocated a free usable stack, which writes the vessel into the
stack's record and adds the stack to that vessel's holdings. A vessel can release a
stack it is holding, which frees the stack's record and drops it from the vessel's
holdings.

The yard superintendent has a privileged override. The superintendent can seize the
yard and release it again. While the yard is seized, the superintendent can force a
new usable set into place without advancing the epoch; because a forced
installation is not gated on stacks being free, it revokes the allocation of every
stack that leaves the usable set, clearing both the stack's record and the holdings
of whichever vessel held it. While the yard is seized, the superintendent can also
reassign a stack straight to a vessel, which writes the new vessel into the stack's
record, drops the stack from the previous holder's holdings, and adds it to the new
holder's holdings.

The complete set of actions is: reconfigure the usable set with an epoch advance,
allocate a free usable stack to a vessel, release a stack a vessel is holding,
seize the yard as superintendent, release the yard, force a usable set into place
by override while revoking the stacks that leave it, and reassign a stack to a
vessel by override.

SAFETY PROPERTY: every stack in a vessel's holdings is recorded as allocated to
that very vessel, so no yard stack is ever held by two vessels at the same time.

---- MODULE W4Od12m5p1t1 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Officers, Adjustments, MaxVersion

NoSnapshot == [set |-> {}, version |-> -1]

VARIABLES record, approved, tally, inflight, snapshot

vars == <<record, approved, tally, inflight, snapshot>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ record \in [applied : SUBSET Adjustments, version : 0..MaxVersion]
    /\ approved \subseteq Adjustments
    /\ tally \in [Adjustments -> SUBSET Officers]
    /\ inflight \subseteq (Officers \X Adjustments)
    /\ snapshot \in {NoSnapshot} \union
                    [set : SUBSET Adjustments, version : 0..MaxVersion]

Majority(a) == 2 * Cardinality(tally[a]) > Cardinality(Officers)

Init ==
    /\ record = [applied |-> {}, version |-> 0]
    /\ approved = {}
    /\ tally = [a \in Adjustments |-> {}]
    /\ inflight = {}
    /\ snapshot = NoSnapshot

CastVote(o, a) ==
    /\ <<o, a>> \notin inflight
    /\ o \notin tally[a]
    /\ inflight' = inflight \union {<<o, a>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, approved, tally, snapshot>>

CountVote(o, a) ==
    /\ <<o, a>> \in inflight
    /\ tally' = [tally EXCEPT ![a] = tally[a] \union {o}]
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {<<o, a>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, approved, snapshot>>

ThrowAwayLateVote(o, a) ==
    /\ <<o, a>> \in inflight
    /\ a \in approved
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {<<o, a>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, approved, tally, snapshot>>

ApproveAndApply(a) ==
    /\ Majority(a)
    /\ a \notin approved
    /\ record.version < MaxVersion
    /\ approved' = approved \union {a}
    /\ record' = [applied |-> record.applied \union {a},
                  version |-> record.version + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tally, inflight, snapshot>>

TakeSnapshot ==
    /\ snapshot = NoSnapshot
    /\ snapshot' = [set |-> record.applied, version |-> record.version]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, approved, tally, inflight>>

WriteBackSnapshot ==
    /\ snapshot # NoSnapshot
    /\ snapshot.version = record.version
    /\ record.version < MaxVersion
    /\ record' = [applied |-> snapshot.set, version |-> record.version + 1]
    /\ snapshot' = NoSnapshot
    /\ UNCHANGED <<approved, tally, inflight>>

DiscardSnapshot ==
    /\ snapshot # NoSnapshot
    /\ \/ snapshot.version # record.version
       \/ record.version = MaxVersion
    /\ snapshot' = NoSnapshot
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, approved, tally, inflight>>

Next ==
    \/ \E o \in Officers, a \in Adjustments : CastVote(o, a)
    \/ \E o \in Officers, a \in Adjustments : CountVote(o, a)
    \/ \E o \in Officers, a \in Adjustments : ThrowAwayLateVote(o, a)
    \/ \E a \in Adjustments : ApproveAndApply(a)
    \/ TakeSnapshot
    \/ WriteBackSnapshot
    \/ DiscardSnapshot

Spec ==
    /\ Init
    /\ [][Next]_vars
    /\ \A o \in Officers, a \in Adjustments : SF_vars(CountVote(o, a))

ApprovedAdjustmentsStillApplied == approved \subseteq record.applied

VoteEventuallyLeavesFlight ==
    \A o \in Officers, a \in Adjustments :
        (<<o, a>> \in inflight) ~> (<<o, a>> \notin inflight)

====

nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker keeps one shared record: the set of stock
adjustments that have been applied, together with a version number that every
write to the record bumps. Each adjustment needs a quorum of the bank's duty
officers to approve it, and each adjustment carries its own tally of the officers
whose votes have been counted for it.

An officer with no vote already travelling for an adjustment, and not already
counted in that adjustment's tally, can cast a vote for it. Votes travel on a
channel with no ordering guarantee, so a cast vote waits in flight and is picked
up in whatever order the tracker gets to it. Picking a vote up adds the officer to
that adjustment's tally. A vote in flight for an adjustment that has already been
approved is simply thrown away as too late.

Once an adjustment's tally is a strict majority of the duty officers and it has
not been approved yet, it is approved and applied in the same step: the adjustment
is added to the approved set and added to the record's applied set, and the record's
version is bumped.

The tracker also compacts the record from time to time. Compaction is a two-step
whole-record rewrite: first a snapshot of the record's applied set and version is
taken, and later the snapshot is written back over the record. The write-back is
only accepted while the version on the snapshot is still the record's version and
the version counter has room; a snapshot that has gone stale, or that arrives with
the version counter exhausted, is discarded instead.

The complete set of actions is: cast a vote for an adjustment, pick up a vote and
add it to that adjustment's tally, throw away a vote for an already-approved
adjustment, approve and apply an adjustment that has reached a majority, take a
snapshot of the record, write a snapshot back over the record while its version
still matches, and discard a snapshot that cannot be written back.

SAFETY PROPERTY: every adjustment the officers have approved is still in the
record's applied set, so no whole-record compaction ever drops an approved
adjustment that landed after the snapshot was taken.

LIVENESS PROPERTY: every vote that is in flight is eventually taken out of flight.

---- MODULE W4Od7m4p3t3 ----
EXTENDS Integers, Sequences

CONSTANTS Cranes, Slots, QueueCap, MaxRefusals

NoCrane == "nocrane"

VARIABLES queue, grantedTo, refused, slow

vars == <<queue, grantedTo, refused, slow>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ queue \in Seq(Slots)
    /\ grantedTo \in [Slots -> Cranes \union {NoCrane}]
    /\ refused \in 0..MaxRefusals
    /\ slow \subseteq Cranes

Queued == {queue[i] : i \in 1..Len(queue)}

Init ==
    /\ queue = << >>
    /\ grantedTo = [s \in Slots |-> NoCrane]
    /\ refused = 0
    /\ slow = {}

AdmitSlot(s) ==
    /\ Len(queue) < QueueCap
    /\ grantedTo[s] = NoCrane
    /\ s \notin Queued
    /\ queue' = Append(queue, s)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<grantedTo, refused, slow>>

RefuseRequest ==
    /\ Len(queue) >= QueueCap
    /\ refused < MaxRefusals
    /\ refused' = refused + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, grantedTo, slow>>

TakeHeadSlot(c) ==
    /\ c \notin slow
    /\ Len(queue) > 0
    /\ grantedTo[Head(queue)] = NoCrane
    /\ grantedTo' = [grantedTo EXCEPT ![Head(queue)] = c]
    /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<refused, slow>>

ReleaseSlot(c, s) ==
    /\ grantedTo[s] = c
    /\ grantedTo' = [grantedTo EXCEPT ![s] = NoCrane]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, refused, slow>>

BecomeSlow(c) ==
    /\ c \notin slow
    /\ slow' = slow \union {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, grantedTo, refused>>

BecomeFast(c) ==
    /\ c \in slow
    /\ slow' = slow \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, grantedTo, refused>>

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Slots : AdmitSlot(s)
    \/ RefuseRequest
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : TakeHeadSlot(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes, s \in Slots : ReleaseSlot(c, s)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : BecomeSlow(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : BecomeFast(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoQueuedSlotAlreadyGranted ==
    \A i \in 1..Len(queue) : grantedTo[queue[i]] = NoCrane

====

CONSTANTS
    Cranes = {c1, c2}
    Slots = {s1, s2}
    QueueCap = 2
    MaxRefusals = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT NoQueuedSlotAlreadyGranted
nl:
A container-ship crane yard hands berth slots to its cranes through a bounded
work queue with backpressure. The queue holds the slots that are waiting to be
handed out, in order, and each slot separately records the crane it has been
granted to, or that it is ungranted.

A slot that is currently ungranted and not already somewhere in the queue can be
admitted onto the tail of the queue, as long as the queue is shorter than its
capacity. When the queue is already at capacity the request is refused on the spot
and the refusal is counted, which is the backpressure the yard planners see.

A crane takes the slot at the head of the queue and has it granted to it, which
removes that entry from the queue. A crane may be running slow, which stops it
taking new work off the queue; a slow crane is never out of action altogether, so
it keeps the slots already granted to it and can still give them back. Cranes move
in and out of the slow state freely. A crane can release a slot granted to it,
which marks the slot ungranted again and makes it eligible to be queued afresh.

The complete set of actions is: admit an ungranted, unqueued slot onto the tail of
the queue, refuse a request because the queue is at capacity, take the head slot
off the queue and grant it to a crane, release a slot granted to a crane, put a
crane into the slow state, and take a crane out of the slow state.

SAFETY PROPERTY: no slot sitting anywhere in the request queue is already granted
to a crane, so a slot can never be handed out a second time while an earlier grant
of it still stands.
